# Sagelight Studio

> Independent app studio in Romania, EU. We build privacy-first iOS and macOS apps led by SageDocs, our encrypted document vault. Three apps, one architectural philosophy: local-first, no tracking, no ads, no accounts, no studio-operated servers holding user data.

## Apps

- [SageDocs](https://sagelight-studio.com/sagedocs.html) — **flagship product**. Encrypted personal document vault for IDs, contracts, insurance, and medical records. AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation (600,000 iterations). Biometric/PIN auth, encrypted iCloud sync via CloudKit. The studio cannot read the documents — by design. iOS 17+ and macOS 14+. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/sagedocs/id6762064711). **Subscription:** $2.99/month or $24.99/year via the App Store, with a 7-day free trial. Read-only mode after trial expiry; users on v1.0.5 or earlier are grandfathered to free Pro access.
- [SageBills](https://sagelight-studio.com/sagebills.html): Smart utility bill tracker for European households. 40+ bill categories, on-device OCR invoice scanning, cost predictions, anomaly detection. iOS 17+ and macOS 14+. Free. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/sagebills/id6762021142). Local-only architecture — zero data leaves the device.
- [SageMeet](https://sagelight-studio.com/sagemeet.html): AI meeting recorder and transcription for iPhone. Whisper transcription and GPT-4o note generation using a user-provided OpenAI API key (BYOK). Includes Private Mode that disables all external transmission. iOS 17+. Free. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/sagemeet/id6761443109)

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://sagelight-studio.com/privacy-policy.html): How Sagelight Studio handles user data. Local-first, GDPR-compliant, zero analytics, zero tracking.
- [GDPR Disclosure](https://sagelight-studio.com/gdpr.html): Articles 13 and 14 disclosure under EU Regulation 2016/679. Controller, lawful basis, recipients, transfers, retention, supervisory authority (ANSPDCP).
- [Terms of Service](https://sagelight-studio.com/terms.html): Romanian governing law with full EU consumer rights preserved. SageBills and SageMeet are free; SageDocs is a $2.99/month or $24.99/year App Store subscription.

## Content

- [Blog](https://sagelight-studio.com/blog.html): Money-saving guides and product updates for European households: utility bill savings, a line-by-line Romanian electricity invoice guide, building maintenance fees, winter heating costs in Central and Eastern Europe, and SageBills release notes.
- Languages: English, Română, Magyar, Polski, Čeština, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Nederlands, Português (PT), Svenska. Each locale has its own home page (e.g. https://sagelight-studio.com/ro/).
- [Press Kit](https://sagelight-studio.com/press-kit.html): Brand assets, press release, and media contact for Sagelight Studio.

## About

- Sagelight Studio is the trading name of Florin Nica, an independent individual developer (natural person) based in Romania, EU. No separate legal entity.
- Apple Developer (publicly verified): https://apps.apple.com/developer/florin-nica/id1889684772
- Contact: contact@sagelight-studio.com
- All apps are built entirely with Apple frameworks (SwiftData, SwiftUI, Vision, CoreSpotlight, CloudKit). No third-party SDKs, no analytics, no telemetry inside any app.
- All web fonts are self-hosted on sagelight-studio.com — no visitor data is sent to Google Fonts or any font CDN.
- The marketing website (sagelight-studio.com) loads the Google Ads conversion tag (AW-17758801825) under Google Consent Mode v2 with all signals defaulted to "denied" — cookieless modeled measurement only, until a visitor explicitly opts in. No GA4, no remarketing, no profile-building.
- Lawful basis for processing under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) (consent) for SageBills and SageDocs; consent + contractual necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)) for SageMeet.
- Romanian supervisory authority: ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro).
